operations.title: Retrieve the records that match your search criteria.

parameters.name: module_api_name
parameters.description: Module name. Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Deals, Campaigns, Tasks, Cases, Events, Calls, Solutions, Products, Vendors, Price Books, Quotes, Sales Orders, Purchase Orders, Invoices, Activities, and custom modules.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: Performs search by following the shown criteria

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Performs module search by email. All the email fields of a particular module will be searched and listed.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Performs module search by phone number. All the phone fields of a particular module will be searched and listed.

parameters.name: converted
parameters.description: To get the list of converted records. Default value is false.

parameters.name: approved
parameters.description: To get the list of approved records. Default value is true.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: To get the list of records from the respective pages. Default value for page is 1.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: To get the list of records available per page. The default and the maximum possible value is 200.
